method_contributions.statement: For any event-clocked theme, re-anchor the identical formula family at non-event times. Here it produced 3.20 vs analytic 2.58 and permutation 2.00, and it was the only null that killed the design winner. ADD TO THE STANDARD GAUNTLET.
In a dollar-neutral sweep, market-adjusted X and X are the same formula. Pre-registering both halves inflates apparent search breadth without inflating the bar. Dedupe before counting N.

Both deaths are the same execution wall from two sides: fundwindow needs ~10x the signal (hopeless), opendrive needs 1.25x (18-20% short, and it got STRONGER out of sample). The structure is real and the spread eats it.
